messages:
Alina: Heads up — planning a phased terraform apply for network + IAM during tonight's quiet window (00:30-02:30 UTC). Goal: route-table updates and SA policy tweaks with a small canary first.

Sam: Can we put a traffic-throttle in front of the canary and use token-bucket smoothing? Also want provider pin if there's any risk.

DeployBot: DeployBot queued apply job t-apply-20260401-09 targeting infra/network and infra/iam. Estimated duration ~18m. Canary scope: tenants=staging,beta-1.

Morgan: I'll own canary monitoring. Watching error budget, 5xx rate, and auth failures. If errors >2% for 5m we rollback.

Ronnie: Escape hatch ready: manual hold is `deploybot hold t-apply-20260401-09`. Rollback pin prepped to previous tfstate snapshot.

Alina: Plan snippet: ```
terraform plan -target=module.route_table -var-file=change.tfvars
```
Split apply: 1) route canary 00:30, 2) SA policy 01:00, 3) full traffic shift 01:30.

Sam: Ops asks: (1) pin provider to `hashicorp/aws` v3.75.0 in the registry mirror, (2) disable autoscaler auto-burst during apply window.

DeployBot: Apply step 1 started: t-apply-20260401-09/step-1. Logs: https://deploy/logs/t-apply-20260401-09 :rocket:

Morgan: Canary steady for 6m. Latency +10% (expected). Auth error spike 0.6% -> within tolerance.

Ronnie: If auth errors >1.5% for 3m we invoke `rollback`. Prep rollback command: `terraform apply -refresh=false -var 'force_previous=true'`.

Alina: @oncall-sre if DeployBot dies or we detect state drift during step-2, flip the pin and abort apply. Call blameline 1.2 if automated rollback needed.

oncall-sre: Acknowledged. I'll be ready to toggle regional traffic and cut rollback if thresholds hit.

Sam: After step-2 run a non-disruptive smoke: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer smoke' https://api.prod.internal/health` and run `evals/quicksmoke` to validate.

DeployBot: Step-2 started. Scheduled traffic shift for canary -> 10%. Note: prefix KV cache flush deferred until step-3.

Morgan: Monitoring green at +12m into canary. No auth failures. Recommend proceed to full 100% shift at 01:30. :+1:

Alina: Proceeding to step-3. Reminder: if downstream rate limits hit, throttle to 50% and open incident channel immediately.

Sam: Quick note to update release notes: provider pin + manual hold commands added to support runbook.

DeployBot: Apply complete — success. Summary: step1 ok, step2 canary ok, step3 traffic shift done. Total duration 23m. Artifacts: https://deploy/artifacts/t-apply-20260401-09

Morgan: Marked 'release' in release notes draft. Will run a follow-up 30m post-shift smoke for regressions.

Ronnie: Nice run. Closing thread. :party_parrot:
